description_en: Deletes sensitive words by calling DeleteSensitiveWord
kebab_example: aliyun imp delete-sensitive-word --app-id 7m000q --word-list 测试敏感词 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DeleteSensitiveWord

parameters.help_en: The application ID of the user, which is generated when you create an application in the console. The value contains lowercase letters and digits and is 6 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 用户的应用ID，在控制台创建应用时生成。包含小写字母、数字，长度为6个字符
parameters.name: app_id

parameters.help_en: The list of sensitive words to delete. Only sensitive words that have been previously created can be deleted
parameters.help_zh: 要删除敏感词列表。仅有被创建过的敏感词才会被正确删除
parameters.name: word_list
